content.title: Sports-Betting Stocks Face Growing Threat From Prediction Rivals
content.summary: Robinhood, which has a partnership with Kalshi to offer wagers on everything from football games to political races and other everyday events, saw more than 2 billion prediction contracts trade in the third quarter alone.  Traders rushed to dump shares of online betting operators, with DraftKings Inc. tumbling over 16%, its biggest weekly drop since late 2022, and rival Flutter Entertainment PLC, which operates FanDuel, sliding more than 8%.

content.title: Robinhood bets big on prediction market. Executive discusses.
content.description:
In August, Robinhood Markets (HOOD) expanded its prediction market to include event contracts on college and professional sports.

Robinhood Vice President and General Manager of Futures and International JB Mackenzie discusses the investor hype around economic event contracts, which encompass the Federal Reserve's interest rate decisions, and other economic indicators.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Asking for a Trend.
